S01.question: Nick jokes that Eric will make everyone count their socks. How should Alice respond?

options.label: Play along
options.text: “Then he can start by counting to four,” Alice said. Nick laughed and showed her where the car was waiting.

options.label: Ask where the others are
options.text: “Where are the others?” Alice asked. Nick nodded at the glass doors, where the next member of the group was already waiting.

S01.question: Damir has joined the group without warning. What should Alice do?

options.label: Say plainly that she is surprised
options.text: “I didn't expect you here,” she said. Damir nodded; his face showed that he had not prepared an opening speech either.

options.label: Put the personal conversation off
options.text: Alice looked at the coffee by the window and decided that a two-year-old relationship did not have to be discussed at an airport. First, they had to leave.

S02.question: Damir reads a message about an upcoming meeting. How should Alice respond?

options.label: Ask whether it affects the route
options.text: “Will we have to change the route?” Alice asked. Damir showed her only the meeting date and put his phone away.

options.label: Leave him undisturbed
options.text: Alice turned to the window. She was not going to guess from someone else's screen which plans had already been made for her.

S02.question: Alice tells the group what article she wants to write. How should she continue?

options.label: Ask what the others think
options.text: She looked at her three fellow travellers in turn. It was not easy to answer first; Nick unexpectedly stopped joking.

options.label: Leave the statement without explanation
options.text: Alice did not justify her thought. A silence settled over the car, and it held more than the magazine's plans.

S65.question: Alice unexpectedly asks Damir about his new scar. What should she do now?

options.label: Do not hide the question behind a joke
options.text: She held his gaze. If Damir wanted to answer, she would listen without making his story part of her own.

options.label: Tell him he does not have to answer
options.text: “You don't have to tell me,” Alice added. She did not want to turn someone else's life into an answer to her own unease.

S65.question: After talking with Eric, Alice wants to know more about him. What should she choose?

options.label: Ask when there is another chance
options.text: She remembered the question but did not demand an answer at once: they still had a shared dinner ahead of them.

options.label: Leave it unsaid
options.text: Alice smiled at Eric. The conversation had already been personal enough for the first evening, and she did not want to close every pause.

S03.question: Damir sits by the window, leaving space between them. How should Alice begin?

options.label: Ask what he expects from the trip
options.text: “You didn't come only because of the hospital, did you?” she asked. Damir looked at her more closely before answering.

options.label: Set the work boundaries first
options.text: “I need to finish my article,” Alice said. Damir moved away from the notebook and assured her that he would not get in the way.

S03.question: By the water, Damir prepares to explain an old decision. How should Alice respond?

options.label: Let him finish
options.text: She did not guess his answer in advance. That did not mean agreement, but it left room for the truth.

options.label: Ask him to speak without excuses
options.text: “I need to hear what you decided, not why it was inevitable,” she said. Damir nodded and began again.

S04.question: They are walking by the water, and Nick joins them. How should Alice continue?

options.label: Ask Nick to show what he noticed
options.text: Nick pointed to a barely visible path in the grass. Alice did not take out her camera; she wanted to hear his explanation first.

options.label: Slow down and look at the valley herself
options.text: Alice paused by the railing. Nick matched her pace without urging her to move faster.

S04.question: The conversation reminds Alice of how she and Damir used to be silent. What will she decide?

options.label: Stop treating silence as agreement
options.text: Alice formed the question she had never asked back then. Next time, she wanted to say it aloud.

options.label: Do not judge the present by an old mistake
options.text: She realised that she did not yet know the people they had become well enough. Today it mattered more to look and ask than to pass sentence.

S05.question: The weather changes the plans, and Eric jokes again that he was right. What should Alice do?

options.label: Suggest a useful alternative shot
options.text: She looked at the wet jackets and the car door. Perhaps the story they were looking for was right there.

options.label: Check that everyone is comfortable filming in the rain
options.text: Alice looked around the group. A beautiful image was not worth replacing someone else's discomfort.

S05.question: Nick and Eric argue about the green pastry. How should Alice join in?

options.label: Play along with Nick's joke
options.text: “I think you already have a winner,” she said. Nick ceremoniously lifted the plate.

options.label: Stay out of it and try something else
options.text: Alice chose the cinnamon pastry and listened with pleasure as two grown men argued about icing.

S06.question: Nick calls to them from the lower path. What does Alice feel?

options.label: Want another minute beside Eric
options.text: She held Eric's gaze for another moment before turning. The simple pause felt unexpectedly important.

options.label: Feel calmer knowing the group is nearby
options.text: Alice turned toward Nick's voice. They were not lost, and they were not planning to make the walk a secret.

S06.question: Damir automatically pours her tea without sugar. How will Alice take it?

options.label: Remember how often she hid changes
options.text: She understood that a new habit did not make the old care false. But now she wanted to call things by their names.

options.label: Do not turn tea into a conversation about the past
options.text: Alice smiled and reached for the sugar bowl. Not every small gesture needed to carry a hidden meaning.

S07.question: Nick wonders what he would never film. What should Alice do?

options.label: Give him time to answer
options.text: She did not rescue the pause with another joke. Nick looked at his fork and searched for the words.

options.label: Ask what matters more than a successful shot
options.text: “Where is your boundary?” Alice asked quietly. Nick stopped turning the fork.

S07.question: During the game, Nick tries to sing without words. How should Alice keep the evening going?

options.label: Join his ridiculous rhythm
options.text: Alice tapped the beat with a spoon against her mug. Nick thanked her with a bow, completely missing the note.

options.label: Offer the next game card
options.text: She put a new card on the table. Nick declared that his talent simply had not been appreciated yet.

S08.question: Damir puts away the medical kit. How should Alice respond to his care?

options.label: Thank him without discussing the past
options.text: She noticed how carefully he fastened the kit. Simple help did not have to conceal another request.

options.label: Ask about the scar and his habit of carrying the kit
options.text: “Have you been travelling with that for long?” Alice asked. Damir looked at his wrist and prepared to answer.

S08.question: Nick points the camera at Damir's kit. What should Alice suggest?

options.label: Ask Damir's permission first
options.text: “It's his story,” Alice said. Nick lowered the camera until he had an answer.

options.label: Film the hands and the kit instead of the face
options.text: Alice pointed to the tools. The detail could say something about Damir's work without a close-up he had not chosen.

S66.question: After working in the greenhouse, Alice chooses how to begin her note. What will she do?

options.label: Describe how they fixed the tag mix-up together
options.text: She remembered the trays and the hands stained with soil. The small shared task said more about the group than a general conclusion would.

options.label: Describe the unexpected hour without cameras
options.text: Alice wrote that for an hour nobody tried to perform another life. The details of that hour deserved a paragraph of their own.

S66.question: Talking with Eric, Alice does not want to rush to a conclusion. What will she keep?

options.label: The wish to know him beyond work routes
options.text: She smiled, imagining Eric in an ordinary house where nobody asked him to check the forecast.

options.label: The right not to decide anything about them today
options.text: Alice felt that a good evening did not need an immediate name.

S02: On the road, Alice remembered Nick joking about the socks and, for the first time, felt like part of the group rather than a guest observer.
On the road, she remembered asking Nick about the others right away. It was easier to meet people when she chose the first question herself.
S08: Over breakfast, Nick remembered how Alice had not rushed him when he answered about filming. He spoke on his own about shots better left unfilmed.
Over breakfast, Nick returned to her question about boundaries. He told her which shot he would never film, even for a good movie.
